oauthHandoff.verifiedBody: Your account was found. Your notes are encrypted, so enter your recovery phrase to unlock them on this device.
oauthHandoff.noPhraseHint: Don't have your phrase handy? On a device where you're already signed in, open Settings → Security → Phrase to view your phrase or QR code.

hydrateError.title: Sign-in didn't finish
hydrateError.body: Your account and notes are safe - we just couldn't finish signing you in. This is usually temporary. Nothing has been changed.

chooseMode.welcomeBack: Sign in or create an account
chooseMode.easySubtitle: Use your Google, Apple, or GitHub account.
chooseMode.anonymousSubtitle: No email, no identity. Just a recovery phrase.
chooseMode.desktopCodeHint: Copy & paste the code from your browser to finish signing in.
chooseMode.resumeTitle: Pick up where you left off
chooseMode.resumeSubtitle: This device is still set up for your account.
chooseMode.resumeFailed: That didn't work. Sign in below instead.

ladder.intro: Your notes are always encrypted on your device. The options differ in who holds the key.

answers.lostGone: Gone, unless a device is still signed in

ladder.footer: <opt>Keep it simple</opt> and <opt>Self-custody</opt> both use a Google, Apple or GitHub login, and you can switch between them later in Settings. <opt>Anonymous</opt> accounts can connect a login there too, and then choose <opt>Keep it simple</opt> or <opt>Self-custody</opt>.

custody.intro: Your notes are encrypted. Choose how your encryption key is stored.
custody.simpleBody: Sign in with the same account on any device. We store your phrase on our server, encrypted under a key we hold. No phrase to remember.
custody.maxSecurityBody: You manage your own recovery phrase. Your key never touches our server. New devices require the phrase.
custody.tradeoffCustodial: Your phrase is stored on our server, encrypted under a key we hold, so a legal order or a server compromise could reach your notes.
custody.tradeoffSelfCustody: If you lose your phrase, your data cannot be recovered. You are fully in control.

trustDevice.label: Trust this device
trustDevice.description: Stay signed in after closing the browser. Uncheck on shared computers.
trustDevice.descriptionRestarts: Stay signed in across browser restarts. Uncheck on shared computers.

createPhrase.warning: These words are the only way into your notes. Lose them and your future data is gone.
createPhrase.saveFailed: Saving failed, so the file may be empty or incomplete. Save it again and check that it holds your phrase.
createPhrase.txtFooter_one: This {{count}} word is the only way into your notes. Store this file somewhere safe and never share it.
createPhrase.txtFooter_other: These {{count}} words are the only way into your notes. Store this file somewhere safe and never share it.

importPhrase.instructions: Paste or type your recovery phrase, or scan a sign-in QR from another device.
importPhrase.placeholder: word1 word2 word3 word4 word5 word6 word7 word8 word9 word10 word11 word12
importPhrase.invalidPhrase: Invalid phrase. Check spelling and word order.

signIn.signupsPaused: New sign-ups are temporarily paused. Please try again later.
signIn.publicPhrase: This phrase is published, so anyone could open its account. Create a new account to get your own phrase.
signIn.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts right now. Please wait a minute and try again.
signIn.authHeaderStripped: A privacy filter or proxy on this device removed a header the app needs. Allow this app in its HTTPS filtering settings and try again, because syncing needs the same header.
signIn.timedOut: Sign-in timed out. Check your connection and try again.
signIn.switchBody: Another account is signed in here. Switching removes it from this device. Its synced notes are safe. Anything not synced is lost.

qrScanner.title: Scan sign-in QR
qrScanner.uploadHint: Camera not picking it up? Upload a photo or screenshot of the QR instead.
qrScanner.footer: Point your camera at a <brand/> sign-in QR. Your phrase stays on this device. The camera feed is not uploaded.
qrScanner.noCamera: This device doesn't have a camera we can access.
qrScanner.notSignInCode: That QR isn't a PrivacyNotes sign-in code.
qrScanner.imageNotSignInCode: That image has a QR, but it isn't a PrivacyNotes sign-in code.
qrScanner.imageUnreadable: Couldn't read a QR from that image. Try a sharper screenshot or photo.
qrScanner.permissionDenied: Camera permission was denied. Allow camera access in your browser settings and try again.
qrScanner.cameraNotFound: We couldn't find a camera on this device.
qrScanner.staleTab: PrivacyNotes was updated since you opened this tab. Refresh the page, then try again - the upload-image button below also works without restarting the camera.

qrSignInPrompt.title: Sign in with scanned QR?
qrSignInPrompt.body: A sign-in QR was detected in the URL. Only continue if you scanned this code yourself. Anyone can make a QR, and signing in will use the scanned phrase for this device.

loginForm.ambiguousHint: Ambiguous characters (0, O, o, l, 1, I) are automatically removed to avoid confusion.
loginForm.lettersHint: Turn either off. One stays on.
loginForm.passphraseHint: Easier to type on a phone and to say out loud.
loginForm.passphraseProBody: A few random words you can say out loud and type on a phone.
loginForm.urlHint: This doesn’t look like a URL. Did you mean https://…?
loginForm.totpInvalid: This doesn't look like a valid key. Paste the otpauth:// link or the base32 secret.
loginForm.totpProNote: The key is saved and synced. Only the code is behind Pro.
loginForm.textFieldSearchable: Text fields show their value and are searchable. Hidden fields are masked and never searchable.

phraseReplaced.title: This account now uses a new recovery phrase
phraseReplaced.body: The recovery phrase was changed on another device, so the one on this device no longer opens the account. Enter the new phrase to continue.
phraseReplaced.kept: Your notes stay on this device. Changes that have not synced yet go up once the new phrase is in.
phraseReplaced.replacedAgain: This phrase was replaced too. Enter the newest one.
phraseReplaced.failed: Could not sign in with this phrase. Check your connection and try again.
phraseReplaced.providerTitle: Your login keeps the new phrase for you
phraseReplaced.providerBody: Sign in with the login of this account, and this device gets the new phrase.
phraseReplaced.exportTitle: Export the notes on this device
phraseReplaced.exportBody: An encrypted backup of what this device holds. It opens only in this account, after you sign in with the new phrase.
phraseReplaced.exportFailed: The export did not finish. Nothing on this device changed.
phraseReplaced.signOutBody: An export does not help without the new phrase: a backup from this screen opens only after you sign in with the new phrase. Changes that have not synced stay on this device, and they go up if you sign in here again with the new phrase.
phraseReplaced.signOutRowHelp: Changes that have not synced stay on this device.
